title: You can't miss it
text: The trip was punctual, it is highly recommended to do it at sunset, you can take beautiful photos. The trip was scheduled for 1 hour but we were there for 1.5 so it was worth it
author: rodolfoalexisg

title: Easy on. Beautiful trip...
text: Easy on. Beautiful trip through the bay and out into the Mediterranean. Got to sit on the nets on the front and enjoy the waves.  The DJ kept things light and hopping.  Met some fun travelers. All in all great fun and great value.
author: Brad_R

title: Barcelona for the Win
text: Great experience, tour guide was very friendly & accomodating. Tour guide was very knowledgeable about the tour.
author: Daaudy_D

title: Sunset Cruise
text: On a whim, we decided to go on  the DJ catamaran cruise to see the sunset. It was the perfect way to end the day. Not only was the harbor pretty, the sunset was amazing and the cruise was a lot of fun. We had some people in our group who like to dance so we had the top of the boat turned into a dance party and made some new friends along the way. Would highly recommend.
author: Sonja_J

title: A MUST!!!
text: Amazing!!!! You must book when travelling to Barcelona. Excellent drinks onboard and the service is fantastic.
author: E21JUvincentg

title: Sunset Cataraman Trip
text: This was such and amazing experience. Watching the sunset and having a great DJ on board! Great Value for money. We got 1.5hrs tour instead of 1hr too!
author: Tasnim_K

title: Sail
text: This is a great cruise. My friends and I really enjoyed. the crew also make the tour great. This cruise is easy to locate. After the cruise you can walk over to the mall. There is a huge mall that is about a 5 min walk.
author: Sarah_D

title: What a great evening!
text: Went with my mum and we had a great experience. The live jazz music was so soothing so therapeutic, didn't know it was something we needed till we got there! The crew looked after us and it was so lovely to cruise the sea. Love it!
author: ingramp2017

title: Good activity to do at the end of the trip
text: Relaxing, easy and enjoyable. We went real smooth with the water, sunset is beautiful and music is great
author: Christopher_R

title: Sunset Cruise on Catamaran in Barcelona
text: Paulo performed live music in English and Spanish, and he sang really well. The staff were helpful and friendly. Stellar views of the city. Magnificent experience.
author: Aidan_S
